package.name: mongla_localization
package.description: Where the vehicle is, and which way it faces. The estimation layer that sits between perception and control: the invariant filter and its replay of late measurements, the course priors, the landmark heading anchor, prop resection and placement. None of it touches a pixel: every module takes measurements in and produces a pose. The image readers (PnP, the tile grating, the lane line) live in mongla_vision; the node plumbing in mongla_runtime.
